title: Enersens (Formerly Gu techno)
content: Enersens is a French company specializing in the development and manufacturing of high-performance aerogel-based insulation solutions. Formerly known as Gu techno, the company produces innovative silica aerogel materials for thermal and acoustic insulation in industrial, building, and transportation sectors. Their proprietary production process allows for cost-effective manufacturing of aerogel blankets and boards with exceptional thermal performance. Enersens serves clients across Europe and has established partnerships with major industrial groups.
